corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez Pauline citation (1 Thess 4:15 'ኢንበድሮሙ ለምውታን' - we shall not precede the dead) and visual inspection show 7th-order 'ሮ', not 'ሖ'.
Both visual inspection of the printed glyphs and the semantic pair 'ብንራብ እያበላኸን' (when we are hungry, feeding us) confirm 'እያበላኸን' instead of 'እያመሰኽን'.
The printed glyph has the three vertical legs of 'ጠ' ('ደነገጠ'), matching line 2, which was misread as 'ፀ' due to ink bleed.
The printed glyphs are three-legged 'ጠ' and 'ጥ' ('አልደነገጠም', 'አታስደንግጥ'), matching lines 7-8, misread as 'ፀ' and 'ፅ'.
